# ADR-3215: AWS encryption: EBS encryption by default setting for account 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unencrypted volumes appear via misconfiguration.

## Decision

Accounts MUST enable an EBS encryption by default setting for account 7 (AWS-encryption-7).

## Consequences

SCPs reinforce the account setting.
